scenes.voice: Money leaves one account but never arrives in the other. A transaction prevents that.
Wrap related writes in one transaction. They either all succeed together, or none of them do.
If any step fails, roll back. The database undoes every change since BEGIN, as if nothing happened.
Keep transactions short. Long ones hold locks, and other requests have to wait.
Save this for the next time two writes must go together.
If this helped, follow, like, share, and subscribe.
